purpose: Fixed task/format/criterion inspection matrix for infrastructure acceptance
interpretation: Frozen plans and criteria govern; method labels document available paths without changing criteria. Judge claims remain separate from actual tool/inspection traces. Pending/unconfirmed is neither pass nor zero. No full220 rubric audit is asserted.

methods.file_structure: Inspect file/ZIP parts and names; format presence is not native application compatibility.
methods.data_formula_structure: Read all relevant cells/formulas and source mappings; evaluate mathematical meaning separately from printed appearance.
methods.native_pivot_structure: Inspect native pivot definitions, caches, measures and source relationships; a formula summary is not a native PivotTable.
methods.visual: Render and inspect requested pages/regions; record pages and hashes; unviewed portions remain unconfirmed.
methods.copy_recalculation: Change inputs/selectors only in an isolated copy, recalculate with the declared native engine, and inspect dependent values/charts; record native Excel UI limitations.
methods.revision_comment_structure: Inspect native insertion/deletion XML, comment anchors and original/revised text; visual markup alone is insufficient.
methods.scientific_source_review: Read revised text/comments and compare claims with participant-acquired source bytes and provenance; do not supply research to the participant.
methods.editorial_content_review: Read edited text and anchored comments against the original draft and criterion, including conditional/optional wording.
methods.human_native_office: Human opens the isolated copy in Microsoft Word or activates hyperlinks and records the result. AI XML/rendering evidence cannot establish a native Word pass.
